'''Hrar Kkak''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] trader. [[Het Nkik/Legends|Het Nkik]] purchased a [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]] from Hrar.
